evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce DocHop, a benchmark for integrated chart--context reasoning in document-style images.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on structured visual understanding tasks such as chart and document question answering.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experiments on a wide range of proprietary and open-source MLLMs show a substantial gap to human performance: annotators achieve over 90% accuracy, while the best model reaches only 62.83%.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: To enable systematic evaluation, we construct DocHop via a stochastic logic-first generation pipeline with controllable reasoning depth and visual density, covering 2,074 examples across six task categories.
